label: Acute Kidney Injury
short_definition: New kidney dysfunction during this hospitalization, such as a rise in serum creatinine or oliguria/anuria, not clearly present before admission.
positive_note_clues: developed acute kidney injury with rising creatinine
oliguria requiring nephrology consultation
initiated dialysis for new renal failure

label: Alcohol Withdrawal Syndrome
short_definition: Clinical alcohol withdrawal that began after admission, with symptoms such as tremor, agitation, hallucinations, or withdrawal seizures.
positive_note_clues: placed on alcohol withdrawal protocol with high CIWA scores
developed agitation and tremors consistent with alcohol withdrawal
treated with benzodiazepines for withdrawal symptoms

label: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome
short_definition: Acute hypoxemic respiratory failure with bilateral lung infiltrates not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload, meeting ARDS criteria during the stay.
positive_note_clues: worsening hypoxemia with bilateral infiltrates consistent with ARDS
met Berlin criteria for ARDS with low PaO2/FiO2 ratio
remains intubated on lung-protective ventilation for ARDS

label: Cardiac Arrest with CPR
short_definition: In-hospital cardiac arrest during this admission that required chest compressions and advanced life support.
positive_note_clues: code blue called for pulseless patient requiring chest compressions
ventricular fibrillation arrest treated with ACLS and defibrillation
return of spontaneous circulation after in-hospital cardiac arrest

label: Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infection
short_definition: Urinary tract infection that developed while the patient had an indwelling urinary catheter, meeting institutional or CDC criteria.
positive_note_clues: developed fever and dysuria with positive urine culture while catheterized
diagnosed with catheter-associated urinary tract infection
started antibiotics for CAUTI after positive urine studies

label: Delirium
short_definition: New acute confusional state during hospitalization, with fluctuating attention or disorganized thinking, attributed to delirium rather than baseline dementia alone.
positive_note_clues: CAM-ICU positive, consistent with delirium
intermittently disoriented and confused, diagnosed with delirium
started delirium precautions and nonpharmacologic measures

label: Deep Venous Thrombosis / Thrombophlebitis
short_definition: New deep vein thrombosis or clinically significant thrombophlebitis confirmed during the admission, excluding superficial IV site redness only.
positive_note_clues: duplex ultrasound positive for femoral DVT
started therapeutic anticoagulation for lower extremity DVT
new upper extremity DVT around central line

label: Myocardial Infarction
short_definition: Acute myocardial infarction that occurred during this hospitalization, supported by troponin elevation plus ischemic symptoms, ECG changes, or imaging.
positive_note_clues: elevated troponin with ST-segment changes consistent with MI
diagnosed with non-ST elevation myocardial infarction during stay
cardiology consulted for in-hospital myocardial infarction

label: Osteomyelitis
short_definition: Bone infection diagnosed during the hospitalization by imaging, culture, or operative findings, not clearly present before admission.
positive_note_clues: MRI confirmed osteomyelitis of the affected bone
intraoperative findings consistent with osteomyelitis
long-term IV antibiotics started for new osteomyelitis

label: Pressure Ulcer
short_definition: New or worsened pressure ulcer that developed during this admission at or above the reportable stage per institutional policy.
positive_note_clues: new stage 2 sacral pressure ulcer identified during skin check
preexisting ulcer progressed to a higher stage while inpatient
wound care consulted for hospital-acquired pressure injury

label: Pulmonary Embolism
short_definition: New pulmonary embolism diagnosed during the hospitalization, typically confirmed by CT pulmonary angiography or other imaging.
positive_note_clues: CT angiogram of the chest showed segmental pulmonary embolism
started therapeutic anticoagulation for new PE
V/Q scan positive for high-probability pulmonary embolism

label: Severe Sepsis
short_definition: Sepsis during the stay with associated organ dysfunction, hypoperfusion, or hypotension, meeting criteria for severe sepsis or septic shock.
positive_note_clues: developed severe sepsis with hypotension and elevated lactate
met criteria for septic shock requiring vasopressors
broad-spectrum antibiotics and fluid resuscitation started for severe sepsis

label: Stroke / Cerebrovascular Accident
short_definition: New ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke that occurred during this admission, confirmed clinically and/or by neuroimaging.
positive_note_clues: new onset focal neurologic deficit with CT showing acute stroke
MRI brain demonstrated acute infarct during hospitalization
neurology consulted for in-hospital CVA

label: Superficial Incisional Surgical Site Infection
short_definition: Infection involving only the skin and subcutaneous tissue of an incision that developed after an operative procedure during this hospitalization.
positive_note_clues: erythema and purulent drainage from the incision consistent with superficial SSI
wound opened at bedside for superficial surgical site infection
started antibiotics for superficial incisional infection

label: Unplanned Admission to ICU
short_definition: Unexpected upgrade to ICU level of care from a lower level (ward, stepdown, OR, or PACU) that was not part of the original plan of care.
positive_note_clues: patient transferred unexpectedly from floor to ICU for deterioration
unplanned admission to ICU due to respiratory failure
required escalation of care and unplanned ICU transfer

label: Unplanned Intubation
short_definition: Endotracheal intubation that was not planned as part of a procedure or baseline ventilation strategy, performed emergently during the hospitalization.
positive_note_clues: required emergent re-intubation on the ward for respiratory failure
unplanned intubation due to airway compromise
rapid response team called and patient intubated unexpectedly

label: Unplanned Visit to the Operating Room
short_definition: Return to the operating room that was not planned at the time of the index procedure, for complications such as bleeding, infection, or hardware issues.
positive_note_clues: returned to the OR unexpectedly for postoperative bleeding control
unplanned trip to the operating room for washout of infected wound
required unplanned OR visit for fixation revision

label: Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia
short_definition: Pneumonia that developed in a patient who had been mechanically ventilated for at least the required duration, meeting criteria for ventilator-associated pneumonia.
positive_note_clues: fever and new infiltrate on CXR in a ventilated patient, diagnosed as VAP
respiratory culture positive with clinical findings consistent with ventilator-associated pneumonia
started antibiotics for suspected VAP after several days of mechanical ventilation
